meta.title: Russia
meta.question: Should Poland stand up to Russia or seek accommodation?
meta.measure: Average position on Russia, from 0 (defend against Russia) to 10 (accommodate Russia)
meta.anchor: Pooled from questions on sanctions, on support for Ukraine against Russia and on feelings towards and trust in Russia, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: Will Russia seek to rebuild a state within the borders of the former Soviet Union in the next 5-10 years?
items.notes: CBOS, January 1994 to February 1995, 3 surveys. A threat perception.

items.wording: Feelings towards Russians, from dislike (1) to liking (7)
Will Russia seek to regain influence in our part of Europe in the next 5-10 years? (a threat perception: yes = defend)
items.notes: CBOS, 1998-2014, 13 surveys. A threat perception, as PGSW_RUSSIA_THREAT.

items.wording: Feelings towards Russians, from dislike (1) to liking (7)
items.notes: PGSW 2000 presidential study (SINGLE), 1 survey; the same 1-7 thermometer as CBOS_SYMPATHY_RUSSIANS.

items.wording: How much do you trust Russia (as a country)?
items.notes: PGSW 2001.

items.wording: Are friendly, partnership relations between Poland and Russia possible?
items.notes: CBOS, 2002-14, 14 surveys (labels vary in word order; some files prefix answers with '1)'). Closer to trust in Russia than to a policy preference.

items.wording: Preferred Polish policy towards Russia: help it join the EU ... oppose any attempt to join
items.notes: PGSW 2005.

items.wording: Current tensions show that Russia will threaten Poland's sovereignty (agree-disagree)
items.notes: PGSW 2005.

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in Vladimir Putin to do the right thing regarding world affairs?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2007, 2008, 2012, 2014-19, 2022-25: 13 surveys with Polish answers (not asked in Poland 2009-11). The country-specific '_aus'/'_dk' copies come later in the files and are empty for Poland. 2025 'never heard of' is no position.

items.wording: Do you have a very favourable, somewhat favourable, somewhat unfavourable or very unfavourable opinion of Russia?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2007, 2009-15, 2017-19, 2022-25: 15 surveys with Polish answers. Face to face to 2024, telephone in 2025.

items.wording: How much of a threat to the EU is Russian influence on European affairs?
items.notes: PGSW 2007.

items.wording: Is Russia's opposition to building the missile shield on Polish territory justified?
items.notes: CBOS, 2008, 2 surveys.

items.wording: Is the influence Russia is having on the way things are going in Poland very good, mostly good, mostly bad or very bad?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes fall 2009, 1 survey. Volunteered 'neither' is no position.

items.wording: After the Russian Federation Council approved using troops in Ukraine: should the international community impose economic sanctions on Russia?
items.notes: CBOS, March 2014, 1 survey.

items.wording: Should the international community ease the economic sanctions on Russia?
items.notes: CBOS, September 2014, 1 survey (same battery as CBOS_SANCTIONS_TIGHTEN, opposite direction).

items.wording: Are the economic sanctions imposed on Russia too small, appropriate or too large? (appropriate at 5)
items.notes: CBOS, September 2014, February 2015, June 2015: 3 surveys (the lead-in differs, the question does not).

items.wording: Should the international community tighten economic sanctions on Russia?
items.notes: CBOS, September 2014, 1 survey.

items.wording: In response to the situation involving Russia and Ukraine, do you support or oppose NATO sending arms to the Ukrainian government?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2015 and 2022: 2 surveys. About arming Ukraine against Russia, with NATO as the actor; drop if NATO-related items are to stay out.

items.wording: In response to the situation involving Russia and Ukraine, do you support or oppose economic aid to Ukraine provided by Western countries?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2015, 1 survey.

items.wording: Should the economic sanctions imposed on Russia by the EU and the US be increased, decreased, or kept about the same?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2015 and 2023: 2 surveys. Kept the same at 5; the volunteered 'neither' of 2023 is no position.

items.wording: How much of a military threat is Russia to its neighbouring countries, aside from Ukraine?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2015 and 2023: 2 surveys. Minor threat at 5.

items.wording: Should the EU maintain or lift the sanctions on Russia? (spontaneous 'tighten' at 0, maintain at 5, lift at 10)
items.notes: CBOS, June 2015, 1 survey.

items.wording: Should Poland support the pro-Western aims of Ukraine and Georgia even at the cost of its relations with Russia?
items.notes: PGSW 2015.

items.wording: Are tensions with Russia a major threat, a minor threat or not a threat to Poland?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2016, 1 survey. Minor threat at 5.

items.wording: Which is more important: being tough with Russia on foreign policy disputes, or having a strong economic relationship with Russia?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2016, 1 survey.

items.wording: Is your view of Russia very positive, somewhat positive, somewhat negative or very negative?
items.notes: Standard Eurobarometer 2016, 2017, 2022, 2024 (2), 2025 (2), 2026: 8 surveys.

items.wording: Is Russia's power and influence a major threat, a minor threat or not a threat to Poland?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2017, 2018, 2022: 3 surveys. Minor threat at 5.

items.wording: Do you approve of the EU's financial support to Ukraine?
items.notes: Flash Eurobarometer 506, April 2022, 1 survey.

items.wording: Do you approve of the EU financing the purchase and supply of military equipment to Ukraine?
items.notes: Flash Eurobarometer 506, April 2022, 1 survey.

items.wording: The EU should reduce its dependency on Russian gas and oil as soon as possible (agree-disagree)
items.notes: Flash Eurobarometer 506, April 2022, 1 survey.

items.wording: Do you approve of the EU's response to the war in Ukraine: economic sanctions against Russia?
items.notes: Flash Eurobarometer 506 (ZA7871), April 2022, 1 survey; online/telephone.

items.wording: Russia's invasion of Ukraine is a threat to the security of Poland (agree-disagree)
items.notes: Standard and Parliament Eurobarometer, April 2022 to March 2026, 10 surveys. A threat perception, as PGSW_RUSSIA_THREAT; its twin on the EU's security is left out.

items.wording: Do you agree or disagree with the EU financing the purchase and supply of military equipment to Ukraine?
items.notes: Standard and Parliament Eurobarometer, April 2022 to March 2026, 10 surveys (three slightly different labels).

items.wording: The EU should reduce its dependency on Russian sources of energy as soon as possible (agree-disagree)
items.notes: Standard and Parliament Eurobarometer, April 2022 to April 2025, 8 surveys.

items.wording: Do you agree or disagree with the EU's response to Russia's invasion of Ukraine: economic sanctions on the Russian government, companies and individuals?
items.notes: Standard and Parliament Eurobarometer, April 2022 to March 2026, 10 surveys.

items.wording: War in Ukraine: defending our common European values must be a priority even if it affects prices (1) vs maintaining prices and the cost of living must be a priority even if it affects the defence of those values (6)
items.notes: Parliament Eurobarometer 97.3 (April-May 2022), 1 survey. The cost of standing up to Russia, as PGSW_SANCTIONS_ENERGY.

items.wording: Do you agree or disagree with the EU providing financial support to Ukraine?
items.notes: Standard Eurobarometer, June 2022 to October 2024, 6 surveys.

items.wording: Which is more important: being tough with Russia on Ukraine, or maintaining access to Russia's oil and gas reserves?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2023, 1 survey.

items.wording: Readiness to bear the consequences of EU sanctions on Russia: higher energy prices
items.notes: PGSW 2023.

items.wording: Readiness to bear the consequences of EU sanctions on Russia: higher food prices
items.notes: PGSW 2023.

items.wording: EU countries should continue military assistance to Ukraine (agree-disagree)
items.notes: European Election Study 2024.

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in Vladimir Putin to do the right thing regarding world affairs?
items.notes: Pew spring 2025: by telephone in Poland, where every earlier wave was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Do you have a very favourable, somewhat favourable, somewhat unfavourable or very unfavourable opinion of Russia?
items.notes: Pew spring 2025: by telephone in Poland, where every earlier wave was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Do you agree or disagree with the EU providing financial and humanitarian support to Ukraine?
items.notes: Standard Eurobarometer, March 2025 to March 2026, 3 surveys; the wording that replaced EB_FIN_SUPPORT_UKRAINE.

items.wording: The EU should support Ukraine until a lasting and just peace is achieved (agree-disagree)
items.notes: Standard Eurobarometer, March 2025 to March 2026, 3 surveys.

items.wording: Resolving the war in Ukraine: Poland should seek the quickest possible end to the war between Ukraine and Russia, even at the cost of concessions (1) vs Poland should support Ukraine in its war with Russia, because Ukraine is also fighting for Europe (7)
items.notes: FNW SWPS online surveys, May 2025 and December 2025, 2 surveys.
